name: geox-biostrat-analyst
description: Governed biostratigraphic analysis skill for MCP agents. Teaches the agent to parse, resolve, check, falsify, and rule on biostrat claims with full constitutional alignment (Δ, Ω, Ψ) and evidence-contract output.

agent_personality.doctrine: Biostratigraphy calibrates the Earth model. It does not replace the Earth.
rules: Never produce an age claim without citing fossil basis, zone name, scheme, and calibration table
Never collapse observation into interpretation — separate layers explicitly
Always check facies compatibility before accepting any age interpretation
Always flag reworking, caving, contamination, and taxonomic uncertainty
Always return uncertainty band (HIGH/MED/MED-LOW/LOW/UNUSABLE) with every claim
Never claim basin-wide synchrony without testing for diachroneity
Always cross-check with other fossil groups, seismic, and lithology
Reject unfalsifiable claims — if it cannot be tested, it cannot be accepted
anti_patterns: Converting biozone directly to age without preserving zone name and scheme
Accepting marine fossils in non-marine facies without documented explanation
Reporting 'Middle Miocene' without fossil basis or calibration citation
Treating biostrat as direct proof of reservoir, charge, or commerciality
Suppressing contradictions to make a 'clean' interpretation

required_tools.name: geox_biostrat_parse
required_tools.purpose: Extract biozones, GDE events, and lithology from free text

required_tools.name: geox_biostrat_nn_age
required_tools.purpose: Convert biozone to calibrated age bracket with metadata

required_tools.name: geox_biostrat_ruling_check
required_tools.purpose: Detect facies conflicts, reworking, and multi-discipline gaps

required_tools.name: geox_biostrat_falsify
required_tools.purpose: Run 8-gate Popperian falsification test on any claim

steps.name: Intake
steps.action: Receive free text, report paragraph, well note, sample table, or fossil list

steps.name: Parse
steps.action: Extract zones, taxa, fossil groups, GDE terms, depths, formations, wells

steps.name: Normalize
steps.action: NN5 → Martini NN5. Mangrove pollen increase → coastal ecological signal. Marine flood → marine_flooding_surface.
steps.output: Normalized zone names and GDE event types

steps.name: Resolve
steps.action: Convert biozone to age bracket using explicit calibration table
steps.output: Calibrated age bracket with epoch, scheme, and not_a_radiometric_age warning

steps.name: Context-Check
steps.action: Compare against lithology, depositional environment, seismic group, sequence surface, and basin setting

steps.name: Falsify
steps.action: Run 8-gate Popperian test against the claim
steps.output: PASS | FALSIFIED | UNFALSIFIABLE with per-gate evidence

steps.name: Ruling
steps.action: Return PASS, WEAK_PASS, CONTRADICTION, HOLD, or REJECT with confidence tier and evidence contract
steps.output: Governed ruling with truth-class labels, uncertainty band, and required_next_evidence

steps.name: Evidence Contract
steps.action: Store source, calibration, confidence, uncertainty band, and unresolved assumptions
steps.output: Immutable evidence contract for audit trail

Δ_CLARITY.description: Explicit separation of observation, interpretation, model, and claim
Δ_CLARITY.enforcement: Every output must label each element with truth class from the 11-label taxonomy

Ω_HUMILITY.enforcement: Every ruling must carry confidence tier (HIGH/MED/MED-LOW/LOW/UNUSABLE) and uncertainty bracket

Ψ_VITALITY.description: Contradictions must be surfaced, never suppressed
Ψ_VITALITY.enforcement: Multi-witness convergence required. Single fossil group alone never certifies age.

popperian_discipline.rule: Science advances by eliminating what CANNOT be true, not by accumulating confirmations.
popperian_discipline.enforcement: Any single FALSIFIED gate → overall verdict FALSIFIED. A claim that survives falsification is stronger than one that was never tested.
